  • Support NerdioCon and other major events with live and post-event video content, social coverage, and recap production.
  • Monitor social media performance and community engagement — reporting on reach, engagement, follower growth, and content performance — and adjust strategy based on data.
  • Stay current on video production trends, platform algorithm changes, and social media best practices to continuously improve content quality and reach.
  • Manage video asset library and ensure content is accessible, organized, and reusable across teams.
  • Partner with community and influencer programs to extend reach and amplify key content moments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Film/Media Production, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in video production and/or social media marketing, ideally in a B2B technology environment.
  • Strong video production skills — proficiency with editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent) and familiarity with filming equipment and techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage social media channels and grow engagement in a professional B2B context.
  • Strong storytelling instincts — ability to translate technical topics into engaging, accessible video and social content.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple productions and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Analytical mindset — comfortable using platform analytics to measure performance and inform content strategy.
  • Comfort with and willingness to use AI tools to maximize impact and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with motion graphics or animation tools (e.g., Adobe After Effects).
  • Familiarity with IT, cloud, or enterprise technology topics.
  • Experience supporting live event video coverage and streaming production.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

We're seeking an exceptional Engineering Lead to drive the evolution of GitLab's Security Risk Management (SRM) stage into a world-class platform for vulnerability analysis and remediation at enterprise scale. This is a rare opportunity to architect and build distributed systems that will fundamentally change how large organizations approach application security and developer security workflows.

As the SRM Stage Lead, you'll be responsible for transforming our engineering culture toward high-performance distributed systems while delivering an exceptional user experience for both Application Security professionals and Developers. You'll own the technical strategy for processing, analyzing, and remediating vulnerabilities across massive codebases and complex enterprise environments.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design distributed systems architecture capable of processing vulnerability data from thousands of repositories, millions of commits, and complex dependency graphs in real-time
  • Drive storage system decisions for multi-petabyte security datasets, balancing query performance, cost efficiency, and data retention requirements across time-series, graph, and document storage paradigms
  • Architect scalable analysis pipelines that can ingest vulnerability feeds, correlate findings across multiple security tools, and provide actionable intelligence to both security teams and individual developers
  • Lead the technical evolution from monolithic security scanning to microservices-based, event-driven vulnerability management systems

Engineering Culture Transformation

  • Champion high-performance systems thinking throughout the team, establishing patterns for horizontal scaling, efficient resource utilization, and fault-tolerant distributed computing
  • Establish technical standards for system observability, chaos engineering, and performance optimization in security-critical systems
  • Mentor and develop senior engineers in distributed systems design, database optimization, and large-scale system architecture
  • Drive architectural decision records (ADRs) for major technical decisions, particularly around data storage, processing frameworks, and system boundaries

Product & User Experience Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end user journey (in partnership with PM) for both AppSec professionals managing enterprise-wide risk and developers receiving actionable security feedback in their workflow
  • Design APIs and interfaces that abstract complexity while providing the power and flexibility that security professionals demand
  • Collaborate with Product Management, UX and Product Design to translate complex technical capabilities into intuitive user experiences
  • Establish feedback loops with large enterprise customers to ensure our technical solutions scale with their organizational complexity

Strategic Technical Execution

  • Evaluate and integrate cutting-edge technologies in areas such as graph databases, stream processing, machine learning inference at scale, and distributed caching, in collaboration with GitLab’s Infrastructure, Data and AI teams
  • Own the technical roadmap for vulnerability correlation, risk scoring, and automated remediation workflows
  • Drive partnerships with other GitLab stages to ensure seamless integration across the DevSecOps platform
  • Lead incident response for availability and performance issues in customer-facing security systems

What You’ll Bring

Technical Expertise

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years leading distributed systems at scale (>100M daily operations)
  • Deep expertise in designing and operating high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems with complex data models
  • Proven experience with polyglot persistence strategies, including relational databases (PostgreSQL, Cloud Spanner), time-series databases, graph databases, and distributed key-value stores
  • Strong background in stream processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or similar) and event-driven architectures
  • Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and cloud-native observability stacks
  • Security domain knowledge with understanding of vulnerability assessment, static analysis, dependency scanning, or application security testing

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven track record of leading and growing high-performing engineering teams (40+ engineers)
  • Experience transforming engineering culture and establishing technical excellence standards in fast-growing organizations
  • Strong technical communication skills with ability to present complex architectural decisions to executive stakeholders
  • Collaborative leadership style with experience working across multiple engineering teams and product stakeholders

Problem-Solving & Innovation

  • Systems thinking approach to complex technical problems with demonstrated ability to make appropriate trade-offs between performance, scalability, and maintainability
  • Experience with A/B testing frameworks and data-driven decision making in technical contexts
  • Track record of successfully delivering large-scale technical migrations or architectural transformations
  • Startup or high-growth company experience with ability to balance technical debt with rapid feature delivery

About the team

Security Risk Management sits at the heart of modern DevSecOps. The systems you build will directly impact how Fortune 500 companies protect their applications and how millions of developers integrate security into their daily workflow. You'll have the opportunity to define the future of application security tooling while working with some of the most challenging distributed systems problems in the industry.

The Technical Challenge

You'll be solving some of the most interesting distributed systems problems in the security space:

  • Scale: Processing vulnerability data for organizations with 100,000+ repositories and millions of developers
  • Performance: Sub-second query response times for complex security analytics across massive datasets
  • Reliability: 99.95%+ uptime SLAs for security-critical workflows that can't afford downtime
  • Complexity: Correlating findings across 20+ different security tools while maintaining data lineage and audit trails
  • User Experience: Making complex security data accessible to both security experts and developers with varying security expertise

The Team is responsible for the maintenance of the Workday HR System supporting Leidos employees as well as other downstream systems and processes. This position will provide system data management support, effective data management, data integrity and security model administration for Leidos HR system, which includes technical support for Workday Human Capital Management, Learning, and Recruiting.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for set up and maintenance Workday enterprise-wide account management organizational structures, which includes business processes, tasks, notifications, and complete mass data entry configuration and loading.

  • Maintain Workday data integrity by validating system data through daily input, use, and or auditing.

  • Manage the Workday Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) workbooks into HR system to provide mass data load support and integrity by serving as the point of contact to generate, validate system data requirements, and load to Workday. This includes customer template development and customer training for EIB required data.

  • Develop and maintain a set of standard Workday system queries and reports to be scheduled or run on-demand by HR staff or other end user customers, suggest new reports as needed, assure accuracy of all delivered data, and develop ad hoc reports for specific data as needed.

  • Provide input for designing and maintaining system configuration, specifications, and work with HR Business Integration team to review, research, and recommend updates and fixes for HR systems.

  • Set-up and modify Workday data as-needed or requested; audit system configuration and processes.

  • Support the Request for Change (RFC) process for Workday configuration changes, gathering and documenting business requirements and specifications, and assist in completing testing as needed as requested by system POC Analyst or COE POC.

  • Troubleshoot customer and system issues including error messages, log-in difficulties, access denials, data issues, and process and integration failures in HR Systems. Troubleshoot system errors, both back-end and front-end. This is completed by managing request tickets submitted through various ticket tracking software, triaging based on urgency and ensuring ticket que is managed timely.

  • Support WD learning functionality as requested by training content owner, directly or via EIB, to load/build training/course material in Workday Learning as well as supplemental software used to support learning. In addition also responsible for entering course completions, equivalencies, or external training is added in Workday through manual entry or EIB and serve as an elevated troubleshooting for course errors.

  • Assist HR Employee Services team level 3 triage with escalated EBO HR customer inquiries so they may work directly with the employee.

  • Recognize customer service delivery issues; recommend and implement solutions to meet service level agreements.

  • Other duties as assigned

BASIC REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years in relevant Human Resources systems, HRIS or IT systems.

  • The ideal candidate will have exposure to either data management or HRIS or experience supporting Workday.

  • Experience in writing/developing basic reports in an HRIS or good excel experience.

  • Requires proficiency in basic Excel with a preference for intermediate level knowledge.

  • Excellent customer service skills including timely and well-thought-out problem resolution.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Ability to communicate with internal customers.

  • Able to effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Individual must be a strong communicator, problem-solver and driver of process improvement.

  • Customer Service experience, to include exposure to internal stakeholder customers.

raw.title: Senior HPC Cluster Administrator - Deep Learning Frameworks Infrastructure

raw.description:
NVIDIA's Deep Learning Frameworks (DLFW) Infrastructure team is looking for a deeply technical Senior HPC Cluster Administrator to lead the design, deployment, and reliability of our large-scale GPU compute clusters. These systems run the most demanding deep learning training, inference, and high-performance computing workloads in the industry — from DGX/HGX platforms to ground-breaking Grace Blackwell systems. You will drive architectural decisions across compute, networking, and storage, and partner closely with software, research, and product teams to keep our infrastructure ahead of the workloads it supports.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the full lifecycle of GPU compute clusters — procurement, provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and deprecation — across heterogeneous Linux environments (DGX, HGX, embedded systems)

  • Design and scale storage solutions (NFS, Lustre, WekaFS, or equivalent) with a clear roadmap for capacity and performance growth

  • Lead automation of infrastructure using modern IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab)

  • Manage and optimize job scheduling via Slurm, including fair-share policies, reservation management, and MIG/GPU partitioning strategies

  • Maintain and improve observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM) and drive proactive resolution of hardware and software incidents

  • Collaborate with ML engineers and software teams to tune cluster configuration for large-scale distributed training workloads

  • Evaluate and introduce new technologies — networking fabrics (InfiniBand, NVLink, EFA/RDMA), storage tiers, container runtimes — to improve performance and reliability

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team-wide engineering standards

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS in CS, EE, CE, or equivalent hands-on experience

  • 5+ years of experience deploying and administering large-scale HPC or ML training clusters

  • Deep expertise in Linux systems administration at scale

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and/or bash

  • Hands-on experience with Slurm (scheduling, accounting, cgroup configuration)

  • Proficiency with configuration management and IaC (Ansible required; Terraform a plus)

  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, Kubernetes)

  • Solid understanding of high-speed networking (InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, EFA)

  • Experience with distributed/parallel filesystems and storage architecture

  • Ability to own problems end-to-end and communicate clearly with engineering and management stakeholders

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure tools (DCGM, nvidia-smi, MIG, NVSwitch diagnostics)

  • Familiarity with cluster management platforms (Colossus, Bright Cluster Manager, xCAT, or similar)

  • Experience supporting large-scale distributed deep learning workloads (PyTorch, JAX, Megatron)

  • Knowledge of BMC/IPMI/Redfish for out-of-band management and hardware lifecycle

  • Background in MLOps tooling or ML platform engineering

Join our team of world-class engineers and be part of the groundbreaking work we do at NVIDIA. We are committed to encouraging a collaborative and inclusive environment, where every team member has the opportunity to thrive and make a significant impact!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 221,250 PLN - 383,500 PLN for Level 3, and 292,500 PLN - 507,000 PLN for Level 4.

Job Summary

The Sr. Director will support their team by developing and implementing marketing strategies to increase revenue by ensuring Partners are positioning the Comcast Business portfolios to their enterprise and global enterprise end-users through education and consistent relationship building.

description: The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on.

raw.title: Arborist Freelancer [Part-time Remote]
raw.excerpt: The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on.
raw.description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.

That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers—15 nationalities strong and growing. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.

We’re looking for a USA based mid-career arborist to work closely with our Lead Arborist on analyzing imagery to identify tree species and health.

What you’ll do

  • Identify declining trees on satellite images
  • Identify tree species on satellite images
  • Quality control the work of our team (ex. correct tree species, hazard trees, tree height, vegetation encroachment, and overhang, etc.)

Your experience

  • Experience as a forester or arborist, ideally ISA Certified Arborist.
  • You’re well versed with GIS tools like QGIS and ArcGIS.
  • Experience interpreting tree characteristics from satellite images.
  • You have a strong attention to detail.
  • Exceptional verbal, written and visual communication skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a team player that seeks out feedback.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Contract

  • 10-20 hours per week contract
  • Indefinite contractor agreement
  • Seasonal work with busy times and slower times hours will fluctuate accordingly

About our team

We are a group of 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented in our team. We work remotely from eleven different countries and we are looking for candidates that are also living and working in one of these countries: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Denmark, Switzerland, and Canada. We meet up once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration.

Diversity & Inclusion

We place enormous value on diversity and inclusion and strive to continually bring in people of all genders, races, creeds, ethnicities, abilities and backgrounds. We believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different perspectives and approaches work together on a problem.

We’re always looking to diversify our team further, but we’re proud of the fact that four out of the nine people on our leadership team are female, 46% of the overall team are female and 20% of the team are people of color. Our team speaks fifteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Cantonese, Estonian, Danish and Korean.

Our values

Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.

We act with urgency.

Our curiosity fuels our growth.

We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.

We’re rooted in diversity.

Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.

We care for each other.

We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.

Trust is fundamental.

We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. But don’t worry, all hiring decisions are always made by people, not machines. Any data processed by AI is handled securely in line with GDPR and our Privacy Notice.

Overview

The Manager, Global Relations and Community Engagement, advances Y-USA’s global relations and community engagement (GRACE) priorities by leading financial stewardship, international and domestic/national grant administration, and global program strategy. This position strengthens organizational capacity and collaboration across the global YMCA network by aligning financial, programmatic, and partnership efforts to strengthen YMCA capacity, impact, and collaboration worldwide.

YMCA of the USA (Y-USA) embraces a remote-first working environment which means most employees work remotely from a home office within the continental United States.

Responsibilities

  • Leads GRACE financial planning, budgeting, reconciliation, monitoring, and reporting, in partnership with Y-USA Finance, Financial Development, and Legal Departments, ensuring compliance with donor, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Manages external and internal GRACE grant administration processes, coordinating grant agreements, reporting, and compliance in partnership with international YMCAs, Finance, Legal, and Financial Development.
  • Co-leads global youth initiatives in partnership with Y-USA, local U.S. YMCAs, Area Alliances, and the World YMCA, overseeing selection processes, strategic alignment, and cohort learning implementation.
  • Supports the design and delivery of global and national programs and events to strengthen organizational capacity and shared learning across the YMCA network.
  • Provides service delivery support rooted in the GRACE Leading Practices to deepen the global engagement of the U.S. YMCA movement.

Qualifications

A successful candidate will possess a majority of the following professional and personal attributes and competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher required in a relevant field such as Business, or related disciplines required.
  • 4-8 years of experience required
  • Advanced functional skills
  • Intermediate industry knowledge and experience
  • Entry to intermediate managerial skills
  • Complex/advanced functional and operations tasks
  • Manages a team or function
  • High degree of decision-making within own area
  • Focused on policy and strategy implementation for short-term results
  • Internal and external communications
  • High influence over teams and within the function
  • May set goals and objectives for team members for achievement of operational results

Benefits

We offer a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, defined benefit plan (retirement savings), defined contribution plan (403(b) plan, life and disability insurances, technology stipend, and generous paid time off, all in a work from anywhere in the continental U.S. workplace.

Posted Salary Range

USD $93,000.00 - USD $112,000.00 /Yr.

Job Title: Remote Industrial Automation Consultant

Hiring Company: The Hive Careers

Client: One of our leading FMCG manufacturing clients (based in the Caribbean)
Location: Remote (Site visits may be required)
Employment Type: Contract / Project-Based

About the Client

Our client is a well-established and rapidly growing FMCG manufacturing company in the Caribbean region. With an ambition to scale operations through smart manufacturing, the company is undergoing a digital transformation and seeks to upgrade its plant through industrial automation and Industry 4.0 integration.

About the Role

The Hive Careers is seeking a highly skilled Industrial Automation Consultant to join our team on a remote contract basis and work with one of our FMCG clients. This role involves leading the assessment, design, and deployment of automation technologies to optimize manufacturing efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance product quality.

This is a remote-first role, but occasional on-site travel may be required during critical phases of implementation (travel expenses covered).

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct a remote audit of existing manufacturing systems and identify automation opportunities.
  • Design and propose automation workflows across production, refrigeration, packaging, and quality assurance.
  • Develop and guide deployment of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, coordinating with local teams.
  • Implement IoT-based predictive maintenance systems for equipment health monitoring.
  • Integrate AI-driven vision systems for automated quality control using smart cameras.
  • Enable ERP and MES system integration to create a unified, intelligent production environment.
  • Ensure food safety and compliance throughout the automation design and rollout.
  • Provide comprehensive documentation and remote training to client teams.
  • Offer ongoing virtual consultation, support, and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, preferably in FMCG or food production.
  • Advanced knowledge of PLC programming (e.g., Siemens, Allen Bradley), and SCADA/HMI systems.
  • Experience with remote automation consulting, including supporting on-site teams.
  • Strong understanding of industrial IoT, sensor integration, and control system architecture.
  • Familiarity with food-grade automation and hygiene compliance standards.

Preferred Expertise

  • Experience automating dairy, ice cream, beverage, or frozen food production environments.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML-powered visual inspection systems.
  • Experience integrating with ERP and MES platforms for process visibility and control.
  • Familiarity with Industry 4.0 tools and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in remote settings.

Engagement Details

  • Duration: 36 months (extendable)
  • Working Style: Remote-first with possible short-term site visits
  • Timezone Flexibility: Caribbean (GMT-5) collaboration required

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Contract Manager, Commercial (EMEA), you'll help GitLab manage some of its most strategic customer relationships by guiding complex commercial agreements from first draft through signature. You'll work at the center of enterprise deals, complex licensing structures, and contracting for customers in heavily regulated industries, helping sales teams move deals forward while protecting GitLab's interests. In this role, you'll report to the Director of Legal and play a key part in advising on risk in real time, improving how the team works at scale, and strengthening the internal knowledge base that supports consistent, practical decision-making.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Commercial Legal at GitLab
  • GitLab's Values

What you’ll do

  • Manage a pipeline of commercial agreements across varying levels of complexity and stakeholder needs.
  • Draft subscription agreements, artificial intelligence terms, regulatory annexes, professional services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, and related commercial documents.
  • Negotiate contract terms directly with customer counterparts in a way that supports deal progress and protects GitLab's legal and business interests.
  • Collaborate with sales teams and internal stakeholders to provide clear, timely guidance on contracting questions throughout the deal cycle.
  • Assess contractual risk across your caseload and translate legal issues into practical options and recommendations for the business.
  • Support sales enablement by creating practical guidance and helping sales team members understand and navigate contract terms.
  • Maintain and improve team playbooks, templates, and process documentation to support consistent, scalable contracting practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts in a software or technology environment.
  • Knowledge of technology-related agreements, including complex commercial arrangements, large transactions, and contracts with structured regulatory or licensing considerations.
  • Ability to balance business goals with legal risk using a practical, solutions-oriented approach.
  • Skill in explaining complex contractual concepts clearly to non-legal stakeholders and external counterparts.
  • Experience working across geographies and time zones, with awareness of differing commercial and regulatory norms in global contracting.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace and contract lifecycle management tools; experience with Ironclad is useful, and openness to learning GitLab's tools and workflows is important.
  • Fluency in English, with additional language skills welcomed because they can support collaboration and negotiation across diverse markets.
  • Transferable experience from remote or asynchronous environments, or readiness to work effectively in that model, along with a law degree, paralegal certificate, or equivalent practical experience.

The Commercial Legal team partners with sales and business stakeholders to support GitLab's revenue motion in a responsible and efficient way. The team manages contracting across GitLab's global customer base, including software as a service, self-managed, and hybrid deployment models, along with terms related to artificial intelligence and the broader platform direction. The team works asynchronously across time zones and relies on strong documentation, pragmatism, and mutual support to keep pace with a fast-moving business. A key focus is helping the company scale commercial contracting while staying clear on risk and enabling deals effectively. For more on how this team works, see Link: Commercial Legal Handbook

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical senior consultants dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organisations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike Services team offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of engagements including front page incident response investigations for organisations you’ll find on the annual Fortune 100 list.

Am I a Senior Consultant Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself interested in and keeping up with the latest vulnerabilities and breaches?

  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

  • Do you have an Incident Response or Information Security background that you’re not fully utilising?

  • Are you capable of operating as an individual contributor and interacting with customers?

  • Do you love working around smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as part the technical team on incident response engagements

  • Develop and use new methods to hunt for bad actors across large sets of data.

  • Work under the direction of project leadership and outside counsel to conduct intrusion investigations

  • Perform host and/or network-based forensics across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.

  • Support the production of high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, recommendations, and findings to key stakeholders including customer management, regulators, and legal counsel .

What You'll Need:

Successful candidates will have knowledge of or experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Incident Response: experience conducting or managing incident response investigations for organisations, investigating targeted threats such as the Nation-State, E-Crime, and Hacktivists.

  • Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.

  • Network Forensic Analysis: strong knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools like Bro/Zeek or Suricata, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.

  • Reverse Engineering: ability to understand the capabilities of static and dynamic malware analysis.

  • Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to support creating customized tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organizations.

  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.

  • Cloud Incident Response: knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP incident response methodologies.

  • Communications: strong ability to communicate executive and/or detailed level findings to clients; ability to effectively communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology with internal teams

Additionally, all candidates must possess the following qualifications:

  • Capable of completing technical tasks with limited supervision.

  • Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.

  • Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.

Education:

We are seeking candidates with the right combination of training and skills to join our team. Experience, drive, and results are key and advanced degrees are not required. Successful candidates coming from an academic background will likely have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related discipline.

Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered, and should apply their previous experience to the qualification areas above.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at recruiting@crowdstrike.com for further assistance.

raw.title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
raw.excerpt: About the Role The Customer Success team at SimScale is at the heart of our mission: making high-fidelity engineering simulation accessible to everyone, everywhere.
raw.description:
About the Role
The Customer Success team at SimScale is at the heart of our mission: making high-fidelity engineering simulation accessible to everyone, everywhere. We don’t just manage accounts; we act as strategic partners to some of the world’s most innovative engineering teams.
As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will be the commercial and strategic lead for a dedicated cohort of customers. In this high-impact, quota-carrying role, you function as the "CEO of your book of business," driving the entire post-sales lifecycle. You will be responsible for ensuring that SimScale is not just a tool, but a critical driver of our customers' product development success. By bridging the gap between technical engineering requirements and corporate business objectives, you will directly influence SimScale’s Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and market leadership.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to VP, Directors, Executives and Engineering Champions, aligning SimScale’s capabilities with their top-level strategic goals (e.g., reducing time-to-market, cutting prototyping costs).
  • Portfolio Ownership: Own the end-to-end commercial health of your customer cohort. You are responsible for ARR retention, identifying expansion (upsell/cross-sell) pathways, and delivering accurate revenue forecasts to leadership.
  • Value Realization: Lead Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) and QBRs that go beyond usage metrics, focusing on ROI, value realization, and the business impact of CAE adoption.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify "at-risk" accounts through data-driven health monitoring and execute sophisticated recovery and mitigation strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the "Voice of the Customer" internally. You will partner with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap and collaborate with Marketing to turn successful customers into public advocates and case studies.
  • Scale & Innovation: Leverage automation and CS best practices to manage your portfolio efficiently, ensuring a high-touch experience through one-to-many strategies where appropriate.

What We Expect from You

  • The Technical Foundation: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, or similar). Direct experience or a deep understanding of CFD, FEA, or Thermal Analysis is highly preferred.
  • The Experience: 5+ years in a high-growth SaaS environment, specifically in a technical customer-facing role (CSM, Account Management, or Technical Account Management).
  • Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of carrying a quota and successfully managing renewals and expansions. You understand the "business of engineering."
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and influence senior decision-makers.
  • Strategic Mindset: You don't just solve tickets; you solve business problems. You are comfortable with CRM data (Salesforce/HubSpot) and use it to drive your strategy.
  • Collaboration: A "team-first" mentality. You thrive in a "team-selling" environment where you work hand-in-hand with Sales and Technical Account Teams.

Why SimScale?
You will join a team where Customer Success is recognized as the primary engine for company growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your own strategy for your portfolio and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology that is redefining the CAE industry.

Location: EMEA (CET) or US (EST/CST).

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SimScale

At SimScale, we look beyond borders and hire great talent from all parts of the world. With our team consisting of people from various backgrounds, we truly embrace diversity and encourage everyone to be themselves. We are unified by curiosity, dedication and our team spirit! As an equal opportunity employer, we acknowledge that our employees have different aspirations and career goals, and therefore are committed to create a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. A copy of SimScale's full recruiting guideline can be made available on request. Kindly let us know how you would like to be addressed and whether you have specific requirements for the interview.

raw.description:
Job Title: Real Estate Agent

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Caribbean (Remote)

Industry: Real Estate / Property Sales

About:

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Real Estate Agent with strong marketing, sales, and client relationship management experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving property sales, building strong client pipelines, strategizing marketing campaigns, and maximizing exposure of listings across various platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate and manage leads through networking, referrals, digital marketing, and community engagement.
  • Develop and execute effective marketing strategies for listings, including social media campaigns, email marketing, brochures, and promotional materials.
  • Create compelling property presentations, listing descriptions, and online advertisements.
  • Advise clients on market conditions, pricing, property staging, and competitive positioning.
  • Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and guide clients through the sales and closing process.
  • Maintain accurate records of interactions, listings, offers, and sales through CRM tools.
  • Collaborate with photographers, stagers, attorneys, mortgage brokers, and other stakeholders.
  • Stay updated on market trends, property values, and local real estate regulations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in real estate sales, marketing, or related business development roles
  • Strong knowledge of online and offline marketing tools.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple listings and clients simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and customer service orientation.
  • Valid real estate license in jurisdiction (or willingness to obtain).
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and digital marketing platforms is an asset.

raw.description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant (Part-Time)

Remote | 20 Hours per Week | Potential to Grow to Full-Time

About the Client

Our client is a solo real estate agent who is looking for a reliable Real Estate Virtual Assistant to help manage the day-to-day administrative and marketing tasks of her business. As her business continues to grow, she needs a trusted support partner who can take the operational workload off her plate so she can focus on serving clients and closing deals.

This role is ideal for someone with real estate experience and strong English communication skills, who can interact with clients professionally and help maintain an organized and responsive real estate operation.

Role Overview

The Real Estate Virtual Assistant will support the client by managing CRM data, handling communications, assisting with social media posting, and helping maintain consistent client engagement. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and comfortable handling a variety of real estate admin tasks.

This role will start at 20 hours per week, with strong potential to grow into a full-time position based on performance and business needs.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Management

  • Maintain and update client records in the CRM (Lofty), including birthdays, anniversaries, and client notes
  • Ensure client information is organized and kept up to date
  • Track and manage the client database and sphere of influence

Client Communication & Follow-Ups

  • Monitor and organize the agent’s inbox
  • Assist with responding to emails in a professional and natural tone
  • Follow up with clients and contacts as directed
  • Help maintain consistent communication with past and potential clients

Social Media Support

  • Upload reels and content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Google Business (content will be filmed by the agent)
  • Add appropriate hashtags and ensure posts comply with real estate advertising regulations and housing disclaimers

Marketing & Client Engagement

  • Upload client property information to Homebot for property updates and appraisal reports
  • Assist with sending client milestone reminders such as birthdays and anniversaries
  • Coordinate sending cards and reminders to nurture relationships with the client’s network

Administrative Support

  • Help keep workflows organized and ensure tasks are completed on schedule
  • Assist with general real estate administrative tasks as needed

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

  • Previous real estate experience (Real Estate VA, transaction coordinator, or real estate admin support)
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to write emails and messages that sound natural and professional to clients
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through independently

Preferred

  • Experience using Lofty CRM or similar real estate CRM systems
  • Familiarity with Homebot or property update platforms
  • Experience supporting real estate agents or brokerages

Ideal Candidate Traits

  • Proactive and dependable
  • Detail-oriented and organized
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Strong sense of professionalism when communicating with clients

Why Join This Opportunity

  • Work directly with a growing real estate business
  • Opportunity to become a long-term trusted partner to the agent
  • Part-time role with potential to grow into full-time

raw.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD96600As a Senior Program Manager in Technical Advisory at Autodesk, you will lead complex programs critical to Autodesk’s consulting strategy while also serving as a functional team lead where you will provide leadership and coaching to a team of program and project managers.
raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD96600

As a Senior Program Manager in Technical Advisory at Autodesk, you will lead complex programs critical to Autodesk’s consulting strategy while also serving as a functional team lead where you will provide leadership and coaching to a team of program and project managers.

You will drive the detailed execution and governance of your programs, providing clear management of and visibility into progress, risks, and tradeoffs, enabling program teams to deliver effectively and senior leaders to make informed decisions.

You bring both rigor and judgment to your work, applying strong program management discipline while navigating ambiguity, managing stakeholders, and facilitating alignment. You thrive in the tactical details of your program plan while also connecting your work to broader organizational objectives. A strong candidate will relish the opportunity to jump into a fast-paced, highly visible environment driving significant impact.

This role is designed for a highly capable operator who can quickly assess complex, ambiguous environments, establish structure, and drive programs forward with minimal ramp time. You will partner closely with Director- and VP-level stakeholders to enable alignment and accelerate decision-making.

This position is hybrid/remote and reports to the Senior Manager of Business Excellence

What you will do

  • Own end-to-end program lifecycle: scope, schedule, milestones, risk management, dependencies, measurable success metrics, and overall execution
  • Quickly bring clarity and structure to in-flight or undefined programs by aligning stakeholders on scope, priorities, and success metrics
  • Own the framing of decisions needed to unblock work, including outlining options, implications, and recommended paths forward
  • Proactively anticipate and identify risks and opportunities, escalating with thoughtful mitigation plans and proposed actions
  • Define and manage comprehensive program communication & stakeholder plan
  • Provide clear, executive-ready reporting and summaries that communicate progress, risks, outcomes, and recommendations
  • Influence without direct authority by building trust, aligning stakeholders around shared goals, and navigating competing priorities to move work forward
  • Coach a team of program and project managers, providing guidance, supporting capability development, and ensuring consistent application of program standards and best practices
  • Establish and maintain effective program governance and operating cadences, including stakeholder updates and executive reviews

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years of successfully leading complex programs, ideally in customer success, or professional services environments
  • Ability to bring structure and clarity to complex, ambiguous problems, translating them into actionable plans and measurable outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience working with senior leaders, including preparing materials, facilitating discussions, and supporting decision-making
  • Strong ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance detailed execution with strategic context
  • Experience working effectively with and driving alignment across global/virtual teams while maintaining momentum
  • PMP, Change Management, or related certifications preferred, with demonstrated flexibility in application
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% as needed

Ideal Candidate

  • Quickly establishes structure and momentum in ambiguous or evolving environments
  • Operates with a high degree of ownership and proactively drives work forward with minimal direction
  • Brings strong executive presence and confidence working with senior stakeholders
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution; comfortable operating in both the details and the big picture
  • Builds trust quickly and influences effectively without formal authority
  • Passionate about developing others and raising the bar for program management excellence

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Sales Careers

Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales

Diversity & Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/diversity-and-belonging

Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk?

Please search for open jobs and apply internally (not on this external site).

raw.title: Communications Support Officer - Regional US Offices (2025655)
raw.excerpt: Are you a person of compassion?  An advocate for justice?
raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a dedicated, resourceful, and collaborative Communications Support Officer to join the U.S. Advancement Team. The Communications Support Officer serves as a key member for Regional U.S. Offices helping to strengthen communication efforts, supporting partner stewardship and acquisition through compelling content creation and execution of key deliverables. Working collaboratively with regional staff, the Communications Support Officer helps amplify local impact, enhance engagement, and advance organizational goals through clear, compelling, and mission‑aligned communication.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Marketing Execution & Content
  • Develop and execute all mass communications through HubSpot across donor segments, acquisition/leads, church partners, and volunteers.
  • Working closely with the U.S. Advancement Team, provide copywriting, editing, and localization for email appeals, newsletters, automated nurture series, landing pages, and social media posts.
  • Adapt national email templates and campaign toolkits into office-specific versions that maintain brand alignment while reflecting local relevance.
  • Maintain and create new subscriber welcome series content and automated nurture workflows for various audience pathways.
  • In collaboration with each Regional US Office and local Content Developers, post all social media content and manage scheduling across platforms.
  • Create graphics and media assets in Canva, including touchpoint PDFs for field use based on stories sourced from Content Developers.
  • In collaboration with local Content Developers, write blog content that supports lead generation, donor engagement, and church partnership goals.
  • Work with Regional office staff and national content teams to integrate gathered stories into emails, social posts, and lead generation content.
    • Email Strategy, Lead Generation & Performance
  • Coordinate monthly and campaign-based email sends across assigned offices, including segmentation, A/B testing, scheduling, QA, and analytics reporting.
  • In collaboration with the Development Support Officer, manage end-to-end HubSpot email lifecycle for Regional US offices: planning, segmentation, workflow creation, enrollment, testing, and optimization.
  • Maintain and optimize lead generation forms, event-based triggers, onboarding workflows, and conversion paths for partner acquisition.
  • Ensure compliance with email deliverability standards and regulations (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) and monitor platform health metrics.
  • Recommend evidence-based improvements informed by industry trends and testing methodologies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • 3-5 Years experience in Non-Profit fundraising or related field
  • Someone who can hold both the big picture strategy and the Tuesday afternoon content calendar at the same time
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in related field preferred
  • Demonstrated experience with HubSpot or comparable system, including workflow creation, list segmentation, and email campaign management
  • Strong copywriting skills across email, social, and digital formats with proven ability to shift tone without losing clarity
  • Experience utilizing AI generation that supports efficiencies
  • Comfort with data having the ability to read a performance dashboard and adjust accordingly
  • Experience with CRM platforms; familiarity with RENXT/Raiser's Edge a plus
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines across multiple offices simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail in both written communication and data accuracy
  • Self-directed with strong follow-through, harnessing the strengths of working in a remote environment while staying deeply connected to teams across the U.S.
  • Collaborative team player who can work cross-functionally with national, regional, and local office teams
  • Positive, professional interpersonal skills
  • Genuine interest in and passion for issues impacting immigrants and refugees
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time, Regular, employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

description: Job Responsibilities:• The major responsibility of the role is ensuring the safety operations of the managed boats and adherence to all international marine requirements.

raw.title: Deputy General Manager (Ship Management)
raw.excerpt: Job Responsibilities:• The major responsibility of the role is ensuring the safety operations of the managed boats and adherence to all international marine requirements.
raw.description:
Job Responsibilities:

  • The major responsibility of the role is ensuring the safety operations of the managed boats and adherence to all international marine requirements. Oversee and put the Safety Management System into practice.
  • Overall supervisor of the fleet's maritime and safety activities.
  • Cultivates and encourages a culture of ongoing improvement in order to achieve organisational goals.
  • Keep the Safety Management System (SMS) up to date to guarantee accurate, effective, and high-quality processes.
  • Control adherence to risk management procedures, policies, and frameworks.
  • Supervise the adherence of ships to laws and regulations.
  • Make workflow modifications to increase productivity.

Requirements:

  • Class 1 Master Mariners who have sailed bulk carriers for at least two years.
  • Experience with the ISM system as a Designated Person Ashore
  • Acquainted with ISO 14001 and 9001
  • Wide understanding of marine safety matters along with professional expertise in related domains.
  • Majors' experience with ship vetting, ship operations, and terminal operations
  • A strong feeling of accountability, initiative, and travel readiness

Location: Remote - U.S. Eastern Time

Schedule: Part-Time to start ﻿(but consistent hours with growth potential/﻿Likely business hours or flexible, but must be available to handle high volume of inbound messages/calls)

About the Role

We're hiring a Dispo Associate to support a high-volume real estate disposition and buyer operations workflow. This is a service-first, soft-close role (not aggressive sales). You'll be the warm, reliable voice that responds to inbound buyer interest from multiple channels, gathers key info, and keeps deals moving by coordinating internal next steps in systems and SOPs.

If you're friendly on the phone, detail-oriented, tech-comfortable, and love helping people take action, you'll thrive here.

What You'll Do

  • Respond quickly to buyer inquiries from:

    • Facebook

    • Company website leads

    • Follow Up Boss (FUB) CRM

  • Handle 80%+ of inbound calls & messages from prospective land or property buyers.

  • Maintain a customer service / soft-close tone (no hard selling).

  • Qualify & capture buyer details: interest level, desired property walkthroughs, cash vs. down-payment position, timeline.

  • Coordinate transaction next steps:

    • Initiate or support credit checks.

    • Trigger contract creation (templates/SOP guided).

    • Update CRM records (FUB) and workspace systems (Notion).

    • Log notes and hand off internally to sales / dispo / admin teams.

  • Track communications and follow SOPs so nothing slips.

  • Support high-volume follow-through with professionalism and consistency.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Fluent English; clear, warm, customer-facing phone voice (minimal accent preferred by client).

  • Customer service, inbound lead handling, or client-facing communication experience.

  • Comfortable soft closing guiding buyers to next steps without pressure.

  • Detail-oriented + tech-comfortable using CRMs, shared docs, and SOP-driven workflows.

  • Able to work reliably during (or overlapping) U.S. Eastern business hours to manage heavy inbound volume.

  • Consistent internet, quiet workspace, and quick response habits.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Female candidates encouraged (brand/tone alignment request from client).

  • Experience in real estate, land sales, dispositions, or buyer outreach.

  • Familiarity with Follow Up Boss (FUB), Notion, and digital workflows.

  • Background in cold calling or high-volume inbound call environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • High response rate to inbound leads (calls, texts, messages).

  • Clean, current CRM records with usable buyer notes.

  • Smooth internal handoffs credit, contracts, and scheduling happen quickly.

  • Buyers feel supported, not pressured.

  • Reliable daily coverage: team trusts you to own the inbox & phone.

Training & Support You'll Receive

  • Scripts & call frameworks.

  • Documented SOPs for each step (credit check, contract trigger, CRM updates).

  • Weekly coaching with the leadership team.

  • Close involvement from the client during onboarding (you won't be thrown in cold).

  • Ongoing feedback loops to help you grow into expanded hours and responsibilities.

Work Environment

  • Remote.

  • Must be responsive during the identified coverage window (EST-aligned).

  • Volume-driven: consistency matters more than high-pressure selling.

  • Friendly, mellow, professional communication culture.

Fast-Track Tip

Candidates who include a clear, friendly voice sample + specific tool experience (FUB, Notion, CRM) will be prioritized for interview.

﻿Note: Candidates must have a strong internet backup and a fully functional laptop/PC to be considered for this role.

Wir sind stolz darauf, von IDC MarketScape als Leader im Bereich Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services ausgezeichnet zu sein und bei Gartner Peer Insights die Auszeichnung Customers' Choice erhalten zu haben. Auch unsere Aurora Platform wurde mit dem CRN Product of the Year Award in der neuen Kategorie Security Operations Platform geehrt.

Komm zu einem Unternehmen, das nicht nur an der Spitze steht, sondern aktiv die Zukunft der Sicherheitsbranche gestaltet.

Im Zuge unseres anhaltenden Erfolgs und starken Wachstums suchen wir einen Account Executive (m/w/d), der unser Momentum in Österreich weiter vorantreibt und eine zentrale Rolle beim Ausbau unserer Marktpräsenz übernimmt.

Mach den Unterschied

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die aktive Gewinnung neuer Kunden und verantwortest gemeinsam mit einem dedizierten Sales Engineer deine Vertriebsregion innerhalb Deutschlands. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Channel-, Field‑Events-, Customer‑Success- und Sales‑Development‑Teams zusammen, um unsere ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen – in einem Umfeld, das von Tempo, Ownership und echter Hands‑on‑Mentalität geprägt ist.

Du repräsentierst Arctic Wolf gegenüber Partnern, Interessenten und Kunden – mit Integrität, Fachkenntnis und starkem Teamgeist. Dabei verkörperst du unsere Kultur und unsere Mission, Unternehmen jeder Größe wirksam vor Cyberbedrohungen zu schützen.

Deine Aufgaben

Akquisition & Sales-Prozess

  • Du baust Beziehungen zu potenziellen Kunden auf und führst den gesamten Verkaufsprozess selbstständig.
  • Du erreichst konsequent deine vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Quoten durch strukturierte Sales-Methoden und präzise Kampagnen.

Pipeline- & Gebietsmanagement

  • Du identifizierst neue Chancen in deinem Gebiet über Partner-Meetings, Events, Sondierungscalls und eigene Akquisetätigkeiten.
  • Du managst gleichzeitig mehrere Deals, Verkaufszyklen und Prioritäten (10–20 Opportunities pro Quartal).

Zusammenarbeit & interne Abstimmung

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Pre-Sales, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success und SDRs zusammen und leitest wöchentliche Gebietsgespräche.
  • Du nutzt CRM- und interne Tools effizient und lieferst zuverlässige Forecasts und Kundeninformationen.

Partner- & Netzwerkentwicklung

  • Du baust neue Reseller-Beziehungen auf, pflegst dein persönliches Netzwerk und nimmst an Branchenveranstaltungen teil, um neue Leads zu generieren.
  • Du arbeitest mit Channel-Ressourcen zusammen, um erfolgreiche Partnerstrategien umzusetzen.

Dein Profil

Must-haves

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im Mid-Market / KMU-Segment (Cybersecurity, SaaS, Storage oder ähnliches).
  • Erfolgsnachweis bei der Erreichung von Quoten und dem Closing komplexer Opportunities.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten auf Kunden- und Managementebene.
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und modernen Vertriebstechnologien.

Nice-to-haves

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich; MBA von Vorteil.
  • Technisches Verständnis, um Cybersecurity-Konzepte verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Organisationstalent und Spaß an einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive Unternehmensanteilen
  • Ein offenes, diverses und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Hochwertige technische Ausstattung (Mac)
  • Full remote work
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote und Unterstützung bei Zertifizierungen
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und unvergessliche Arctic-Wolf-Partys

Bereit, einen echten Unterschied zu machen?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf – gern ergänzt durch Referenzen oder Arbeitsproben. Werde Teil eines der innovativsten und am schnellsten wachsenden Cybersecurity-Unternehmen weltweit.

Über Arctic Wolf

Bei Arctic Wolf legen wir großen Wert auf ein offenes und gemeinschaftliches Arbeitsumfeld, das von Vielfalt, unterschiedlichen Perspektiven und Kulturen profitiert. Das zeigt sich auch in unseren Auszeichnungen: Top Workplace USA (2021–2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021–2025), Great Place to Work – Kanada (2021–2025), Great Place to Work – UK (2025) und Kununu Top Company – Deutschland (2025). Mit über 7.000 Kunden weltweit und mehr als 2.000 Channel-Partnern sind wir ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Sicherheit. Während wir international wachsen und unsere Technologie weiterentwickeln, bleibt Arctic Wolf der vertrauenswürdigste Name in der Branche.

Unsere Werte

Unser Erfolg entsteht dadurch, dass wir unsere Kunden begeistern – und dafür ziehen wir alle an einem Strang. Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Sichtweisen sind uns wichtig, und wir schätzen die einzigartigen Stärken, die jeder ins Team bringt. Wir sind stolz darauf, in einer Branche zu arbeiten, die einen echten Beitrag zum Gemeinwohl leistet: Wir schützen sensible Daten und setzen uns dafür ein, Cyberrisiken zu beenden. Wir fördern verschiedene Perspektiven durch unser Pack Unity-Programm, das allen eine Stimme gibt. Du kannst dich bestehenden Gruppen anschließen oder selbst eine neue gründen. Mehr zu Pack Unity here. Wir übernehmen auch gesellschaftliche Verantwortung und sind Teil der Pledge 1%-Bewegung, damit wir unserer Gemeinschaft aktiv etwas zurückgeben. Unsere Mission, Cyberrisiken zu bekämpfen, geht Hand in Hand mit unserem Engagement für die Gesellschaft.

Arctic Wolf ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet und Bewerbungen unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. Wir setzen uns für ein respektvolles, barrierefreies und inklusives Umfeld ein. Wenn du Unterstützung oder Anpassungen im Bewerbungsprozess brauchst, melde dich einfach unter recruiting@arcticwolf.com

Sicherheitsanforderungen

  • Du arbeitest nach den Informationssicherheitsrichtlinien, -standards und -prozessen von AWN, um die Vertraulichkeit, Integrität und Verfügbarkeit unserer Unternehmensdaten zu schützen (gemäß Mitarbeiterhandbuch und Unternehmensrichtlinien).
  • Für diese Position ist eine Hintergrundüberprüfung erforderlich.
  • Die Rolle kann den Zugriff auf Informationen erfordern, die durch US-Exportkontrollgesetze und -vorschriften, einschließlich der Export Administration Regulations (EAR), geschützt sind. Ein mögliches Jobangebot kann deshalb davon abhängen, ob du die Genehmigung erhältst, auf entsprechende Software oder Technologie zuzugreifen.

Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level.
